items.title: Eternal Q4 Results: Cons net profit spikes 346% YoY to Rs 174 crore; revenue soars 196%
items.description: Eternal Q4 Results: Eternal, operator of Zomato and Blinkit, announced strong financial results for the fourth quarter. The company saw a substantial increase in net profit and revenue. Zomato's food delivery segment showed steady growth, while Blinkit's quick commerce business experienced massive year-on-year expansion. Eternal anticipates continued growth in quick commerce over the next three years.

items.title: Websol Energy Q4 results: PAT soars 158% to Rs 125 crore, revenue surges 132%
items.description: Solar cells and solar modules manufacturer Websol Energy System reported a net profit of Rs 125 crore in the March-ended quarter on Tuesday versus Rs 48 crore in the year ago period, implying a 158% surge.

items.title: Maruti Suzuki announces Rs 140/share dividend, fixes record date. Check details
items.description: Maruti Suzuki announced its largest-ever dividend of Rs 140 per share for FY26, totaling Rs 4,401.6 crore. The record date for eligible shareholders is August 7, with payment scheduled for September 9, pending AGM approval. This marks a significant increase from the previous year's payout.

items.title: Maruti Suzuki India Q4 Results: Standalone profit drops 7% YoY to Rs 3,591 crore despite 28% revenue growth
items.description: Maruti Suzuki India Q4 Results: The company’s revenue from operations stood at Rs 52,449 crore for the quarter, up 28% from Rs 40,910 crore in the corresponding period of the previous financial year.

items.title: Castrol India Q4 Results: Profit rises 4% to Rs 242 cr; revenue up 9%
items.description: Lubricant maker Castrol India on Tuesday reported a 4 per cent growth in its profit after tax at Rs 242 crore in the January-March quarter of 2026 compared to the same period last year.

items.title: REC Q4 Results: Cons PAT falls 22% YoY to Rs 3,375 crore, revenue declines 5%
items.description: State-run REC reported a 22% year-on-year drop in Q4 profit to Rs 3,375 crore, with revenue declining 5%. Sequential performance also weakened, while expenses increased. The company maintained strong loan assets and announced a final dividend, taking total FY26 payout higher.
